messages.subject: Core drill rig - delivery?
messages.body:
We need to book a core drill rig. What are the delivery options to Kempele? Can you bring it directly to site or is it depot pickup only?

Kurujärven Maanrakennus Oy

messages.subject: Re: Core drill rig - delivery?
messages.body:
Thanks for getting back to us.

Also need to ask about a cement mixer trailer - same question, what delivery options do you have for that one?

Kurujärven Maanrakennus Oy

messages.subject: Framework discount - multi-site booking
messages.body:
Hello,

We are planning a large multi-site framework booking and would like to discuss pricing. Given the volume involved, we think 22% off list rates is justified. Happy to go through the details if that helps.

Perämeren Telineet Oy

messages.subject: Re: Framework discount - multi-site booking
messages.body:
Hi,

Thank you for the enquiry. I've received your request regarding the framework pricing and will look into it. I'll be in touch once I have more to share.

Regards,
Jussi Kärnä
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Framework discount - multi-site booking
messages.body:
Jussi, could you also check if a 13-tonne excavator is available? We need to know before we finalise the site schedule.

Perämeren Telineet Oy

messages.subject: Re: Framework discount - multi-site booking
messages.body:
Hi,

I'll check the availability on the 13-tonne excavator and come back to you.

Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager

messages.subject: Re: Framework discount - multi-site booking
messages.body:
Sorry, one more thing while I have you. We got an invoice for the plate compactor we had recently and there's a charge on it I don't recognise. Can someone take a look?

Perämeren Telineet Oy

messages.subject: Delivery - 13 tonne excavator
messages.body:
Hi there,

We have a demolition job coming up and need a 13-tonne excavator on site. What are the delivery options to Oulu?

Pohjois-Suomen Purkupalvelu Oy

messages.subject: Re: Delivery - 13 tonne excavator
messages.body:
Hi,

Noted. Let me check fleet availability for the 13-tonne excavator and I'll get back to you on delivery options.

Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Delivery - 13 tonne excavator
messages.body:
Hi Petri,

Separate topic - we need to arrange the return of the cement mixer trailer we've had on rental. Can you confirm whether we bring it back to the Oulu depot, and when suits you?

Pohjois-Suomen Purkupalvelu Oy

messages.subject: Re: Delivery - 13 tonne excavator
messages.body:
Thanks for the heads-up about the return. I'll confirm which depot and what timing works for the cement mixer trailer.

Outi Vähäkangas
Regional Manager

messages.subject: Re: Delivery - 13 tonne excavator
messages.body:
Thanks Outi. By the way, is a cement mixer trailer available for a new booking? We have another project starting up soon.

Pohjois-Suomen Purkupalvelu Oy

messages.subject: Request regarding my account data
messages.body:

Please let me know.

Jari Peltoniemi
